description: This file defines the main FastAPI application for the Career Navigator backend. It sets up API routes for health checks, role listings, role details, progress tracking, and database initialization on startup. It integrates with SQLAlchemy ORM models and repositories, and configures middleware and OpenAPI metadata.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: Main FastAPI application instance configured with routes, middleware, and metadata.

methods.description: Handles database creation and seed data initialization during app startup.

methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple status message.

methods.name: List[RoleOut] list_roles(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns a list of all roles.

methods.name: RoleDetailOut get_role_detail(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific role, including skills and recommendations.

methods.name: List[ProgressOut] get_role_progress(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves progress entries for specified role.
